# Goods (generated)

Source: `goods` in `data/world.json` (base prices), `PER_1000` and `OPTIONAL_PER_1000` in `src/sim/classes.mjs` (demand), `NEED_GROUP` in `src/sim/needs.mjs` (group), `src/sim/optional_goods.mjs` (optional goods).
